user.title: Set up OpenPlate
user.description: Create the camera and its registered plates. OpenPlate generates the signing key automatically.

data_description.device_id: Stable identifier using letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
data_description.home_assistant_url: HTTPS base URL reachable from the mounted iPhone.
data_description.recognition_url: HTTPS base URL of the local OpenPlate recognition server.
data_description.recognition_api_key: API key configured on the recognition server. It is transferred only through the one-time HTTPS pairing exchange.
data_description.capture_interval: How often the mounted iPhone captures a frame.
data_description.plates: One plate per line as PLATE=Display name.
data_description.absence_timeout: How long a registered plate remains recently seen.

pairing_qr.title: Pair the iPhone
pairing_qr.description: Scan this code with the OpenPlate app. The code contains only a random one-time token; all settings and keys are transferred over HTTPS and the token is immediately invalidated. Then select Submit to activate the connection.

error.https_required: Enter a complete HTTPS base URL without query parameters.
error.invalid_device_id: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
error.api_key_required: Enter the recognition server API key.

abort.pairing_expired: The pairing process is no longer available. Start it again.

init.title: Manage OpenPlate
init.description: Choose what you want to configure.

plates.title: Registered plates
plates.description: Add, rename or remove plates. Changes are applied after submitting.

data_description.plates: One plate per line as PLATE=Display name. Spaces and hyphens in the plate are normalized.

pairing.title: Pair an iPhone
pairing.description: Enter the complete camera configuration once in Home Assistant. The iPhone receives it through a one-time encrypted HTTPS exchange.

data_description.home_assistant_url: HTTPS base URL reachable from the mounted iPhone.
data_description.recognition_url: HTTPS base URL of the local OpenPlate recognition server.
data_description.recognition_api_key: Transferred only during the one-time HTTPS exchange.
data_description.capture_interval: How often the mounted iPhone captures a frame.

pairing_qr.title: Scan the pairing code
pairing_qr.description: Scan this code in the OpenPlate app. It contains no permanent secret, only a random token that is valid for one HTTPS exchange and at most 10 minutes. Then select Submit to activate the new configuration.

data_description.absence_timeout: How long a registered plate remains recently seen.

error.https_required: Enter a complete HTTPS base URL without query parameters.
error.api_key_required: Enter the recognition server API key.

abort.pairing_expired: The pairing process is no longer available. Start it again.
